### Headline summary
- Anthropic completed the largest IPO in history, raising $81.3 billion and opening 33% above its target price. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/anthropic-ipo-pricing.html), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/anthropic-sets-us-ipo-record-with-813-billion-share-sale), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/frankchu/anthropic-left-279b-on-the-table-at-its-11150-open-4ngd))
- Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/nvidia-engineer-exodus-risk-jensen-huang-ouster-2026-11), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/nvidia-jensen-huang-affair-colette-kress.html), [EE Times](https://www.eetimes.com/nvidia-reports-115-8b-in-quarterly-revenue-under-interim-ceo/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-nvidia-revenue-doubles-ai-demand/))
- Google DeepMind released the Gemini 4 Neon model while announcing a partnership with Blue Origin for orbital AI data centers. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/gemini-neon-antigravity-harness/), [Product Hunt — The best new products, ev](https://www.producthunt.com/products/gemini-6), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-plans-orbital-ai-satellite-launch-on-blue-origins-new-glenn/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p30#a261119p30))

### Anthropic completes record-breaking IPO on Nasdaq
Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq at $111.50 per share, opening 33% above its $83 IPO price in the largest IPO in history. The company raised $81.3 billion in the share sale, with total proceeds including private placements reported at $107.3 billion, valuing the firm at approximately $2 trillion. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/anthropic-ipo-pricing.html), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/anthropic-sets-us-ipo-record-with-813-billion-share-sale), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6046212/anthropic-record-ipo-price), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-19/anthropic-raises-107-3-billion-in-watershed-ai-debut-video))

### Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia and market reaction
Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has exited the company, prompting comments from industry figures like Elon Musk and AMD's Lisa Su, while the company faces concerns about losing top engineers and a drop in market value. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/nvidia-engineer-exodus-risk-jensen-huang-ouster-2026-11), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/nvidia-jensen-huang-affair-colette-kress.html), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/elon-musk-jensen-huang-resignation-michael-jordan-2026-11), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://theconversation.com/nvidia-isnt-the-first-company-to-dump-a-misbehaving-ceo-history-shows-its-in-the-interest-of-corporate-boards-to-act-296800))

### Nvidia reports record quarterly revenue under interim CEO
Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, more than doubling its previous figures, driven by surging demand for AI chips. The earnings update was released following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, with the company operating under an interim leader. ([EE Times](https://www.eetimes.com/nvidia-reports-115-8b-in-quarterly-revenue-under-interim-ceo/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-nvidia-revenue-doubles-ai-demand/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-19/nvidia-is-least-of-ai-bulls-problems-says-noble-video))

### Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Neon model
Google DeepMind has released the Gemini 4 Neon model, a new addition to its AI lineup. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/gemini-neon-antigravity-harness/), [Product Hunt — The best new products, ev](https://www.producthunt.com/products/gemini-6), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/18/googles-latest-midtier-model-gemini-4-neon-is-three-times-faster-than-carbon-and-wins-on-some-metrics/), [Prompt Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ZjDycWzWQbU))

### Impact of US chip controls on Chinese AI and tech firms
New US chip regulations are disrupting Chinese tech and AI companies, leading to canceled deals for Nvidia chips, halted shipments, and warnings from executives about the impact on their AI ambitions. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-19/alibaba-s-ai-ambitions-face-steep-challenge-in-us-chip-controls), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/nvidia-alibaba-china-military.html), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/chinas-moonshot-ai-scraps-150-million-deal-access-nvidia-chips-indonesia), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/alibaba-ceo-warns-impact-new-u-s-chip-rule))

### Google partners with Blue Origin for AI satellite launch
Google announced a partnership with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to launch TPU-powered AI server satellites aboard the New Glenn rocket in Q1 2029. The project, named Project Suncatcher, aims to deploy orbital data centers for AI workloads. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-plans-orbital-ai-satellite-launch-on-blue-origins-new-glenn/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p30#a261119p30), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/google-selects-bezos-blue-origin-data-center-satellite-test))

### AI-generated cyberattack disrupts EU systems
The European Commission confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted its systems for over 10 days, with CERT-EU stating that international hackers used an AI penetration testing tool named ARTEX. The incident highlights the growing threat of AI-enabled attacks on critical infrastructure. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261119/p32#a261119p32), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-cyberattack-artificial-intelligence-eu-october.html))

### Isomorphic Labs AI drug discovery developments
Isomorphic Labs has raised $5 billion for AI-designed drug candidates and partnered with MSD on AI oncology drug discovery. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/naz6J40TZWQ), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/isomorphic-labs-and-msd-partner-on-ai-oncology-drug-discovery/))
